items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Do you remember him? Oh, yes.

ctx.x: No. Uh, yes, I think he did. He played the guitar. But I think more so for himself. Just, uh, you know, to amuse himself. He didn't go out and make a living at it like my father did.
Do you remember? That's your grandfather. Do you remember him? Oh, yes. Do you remember? What was his first name?
